text: Bug #1 (required flag option in src/click/core.py) is fixed: a flag option with required=True no longer gets an implicit default of False, so it now raises "Missing option '--foo'." when omitted. Verified with a replica of the expected test and the full test suite (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).
Looking into the echo/no-streams bug now (utils.py, _compat.py, _termui_impl.py). ETA ~10 min.
Looking into the envvar flag value bug in core.py. ETA ~12 min.
Looking into the argument decorator cls bug in decorators.py. ETA ~12 min.

Fixed: click.echo (and ProgressBar/pager) no longer crash when there are no standard streams (e.g. pythonw on Windows, sys.stdout/sys.stderr is None). Changes: _compat.py now returns None from the cached stream getters when the underlying stream is missing and defines a _NullStream; utils.echo and _termui_impl (ProgressBar, pager) fall back to _NullStream. Verified: echo with sys.stdout/sys.stderr = None no longer raises AttributeError, and the full suite still passes (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Fixed in src/click/decorators.py: the argument decorator no longer pops "cls" out of its own attrs dict (it copies attrs first, like the option decorator does). Reusing one argument decorator object (or using it on several commands) now preserves the custom Argument class. Verified with a repro and the full suite (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Still working: envvar handling for flag options in core.py. No fix landed yet — I could not reproduce a wrong value for the obvious cases (is_flag with envvar, flag_value with envvar, auto_envvar_prefix), so I am narrowing it down further. ETA ~10 min.
Still working: symlink resolution in click.Path(resolve_path=True) in src/click/types.py. ETA ~10 min.
Still working: default_map handling for flag options in core.py. ETA ~10 min.
